d: In this video, Firstpost explains how Democrat Amy Acton defeated Trump-backed Vivek Ramaswamy in the high-stakes Ohio Governor Election 2026. Despite Donald Trump's endorsement, JD Vance's support, Elon Musk's backing and millions spent on campaigning, Ramaswamy suffered a major political setback. Acton made history as Ohio's first woman governor and the state's first Democratic governor since 2006. Did a controversial campaign ad featuring Acton's estranged mother backfire on Ramaswamy? What does this defeat mean for Trump and the Republican Party? Cary Johnston brings you the details on…
